newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Too soon to see grain crop, 1998 set aside-Fischler.
newsitem.headline: Too soon to see grain crop, 1998 set aside-Fischler.

text.p: European Union Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Monday it was too soon to forecast the size of the 1997 grain crop and whether set-aside will be increased in 1998.

"It's a little bit too early to say how much we harvest this year," Fischler told Reuters, adding that the picture will be clearer in May though a set-aside proposal for the 1998 harvest would only come later.
Speaking after appearing before the European Parliament's agriculture committee, he noted that summer seeds have not yet been sown.
The weather up until harvest was also an unknown factor.
Winter grain plantings are four to five percent higher than last year, a Commission official said last week.
Fischler made no comment on set-aside, currently at five percent of the total arable area.
